preconditions.description: The contract must have liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell + burnFeeOnBuy + burnFeeOnSell = 0 (all zero)
Attacker must be able to call setBuyFeePercentages and setSellFeePercentages functions (requires owner privilege)

exploit_hint: As owner, set all fee parameters (liquidityFeeonBuy, liquidityFeeonSell, burnFeeOnBuy, burnFeeOnSell) to zero using setBuyFeePercentages and setSellFeePercentages functions. Then trigger a transfer that calls _takeLiquidity function, which will attempt division by zero at line 639: 'uint256 liquidityAmount = tLiquidity * (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell) / (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell + burnFeeOnBuy + burnFeeOnSell);'. This will cause transaction revert, potentially blocking fee processing and disrupting contract functionality.
